title: The D&D 5e Player's Guide to Commissioning Character Art
excerpt: What a D&D 5e character art commission actually delivers, what to put in the brief, and how class and lineage shape the painting. From a studio that has painted hundreds.
seo_title: D&D Character Art Commission: A 5e Player's Guide
seo_description: A 5e player's guide to commissioning D&D character art: briefs, class hooks, lineage, party vs solo, tokens, and the mistakes that cost paintings.
